上.o: Originally a small line or dot above a longer line, indicating "up". The vertical line was added to distinguish the character from 二 (two). Opposite of 下.
w: top; superior, highest; go up, send up
that level or higher; that amount or more
on the body; at hand; among

Please get into the car.

Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒ zǒngsuàn kěyǐ tātāshíshí shuì ge jiào.
I can finally get a good night's sleep tonight.

I'll be back in a minute.

báitiān shì jiàoshòu, wǎnshang shì qínshòu
professor by day, beast by night

w: interjection of surprise or pain; Oh; Ow

Ǎ! Zhēn yǒu zhè shìr?
What? Is that really so?
啊？你说什么？
Á? Nǐ shuō shénme?
Huh? What did you say?

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

把.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 巴 represents the sound.
w: to grasp (also fig.); to seize; to hold
working hand; member of a work team
to guard a pass; to check on sth

Māma shǒubǎshǒu jiào wǒ xiězì.
My mom held my hand and taught me to write.
真的把我气死了！
Zhēnde bǎ wǒ qìsǐ le!
It really made me so mad!

c.h: Depicts a tongue extending from an open mouth.

告.o: Pictograph of a tongue extending from an open mouth. Visually similar to 舌 (tongue).

to inform; to report; to make known
to leave; to bid farewell to
x: 请不要现在就告诉他。
Qǐng bùyào xiànzài jiù gàosu tā.
Please don't tell him yet.
我爸爸告诉了我要去哪儿。
Wǒ bàba gàosu le wǒ yào qù nǎr.
My dad told me where to go.

今.o: Depicts a closed mouth. Upside-down 曰. The meaning "now" is a phonetic loan.
w: so far; to this day; until now
x: 今天是星期一，对吧？
Jīntiān shì xīngqīyī, duì ba?
It's Monday today, isn't it?
你今晚会来吗？
Nǐ jīnwǎn huì lái ma?
Will you come this evening?
您今年贵庚？
Nín jīnnián guìgēng?
How old are you this year? [to an unfamiliar elderly person]

及.o: Pictograph of a hand (又) reaching to grab a person (人).
w: to involve; to touch upon (a topic)
there's not enough time (to do sth)

x: 请及时就医，听取医生建议。
Qǐng jíshí jiùyī, tīngqǔ yīshēng jiànyì.

It's too late already.

Huǒchē sān diǎn kāi, nǐ xiànzài qù hái láidejí.
The train leaves at three. You can still make it if you go now.

變.o: Phonosemantic compound. 夂 represents the meaning and 䜌 represents the sound.

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.

隊.o: Phonosemantic compound. 阝 represents the meaning and 㒸 represents the sound.

to surpass; to exceed; to transcend
x: 中文越学越有意思。
Zhōngwén yuè xué yuè yǒu yìsi.
The more one learns Chinese, the more interesting it gets.
他们的汉语越来越好。
Tāmen de hànyǔ yuèláiyuè hǎo.
Their Mandarin keeps getting better and better.
禁止穿越。
Jìnzhǐ chuānyuè.
No crossing.
co: to go beyond space and time

緊.o: Phonosemantic compound. 臤 represents the sound, while 糸 represents the meaning.

半.o: Depicts separating a cow (牛) into two halves (八).
w: midnight; in the middle of the night
half of a game or contest; half-court
half of the day; a long time; quite a while
x: 我去过中国一半的地方。
Wǒ qù guò zhōngguó yībàn de dìfāng.

她扭捏了好半天才说出来话。
Tā niǔniē le hǎo bàntiān cái shuō chūlái huà.
She acted shy for a quite while before she spoke.

c.h: Depicts food or drink filling up its container.
Depicts a vessel for holding food or drink.

w: day by day; more and more; increasingly
x: 科技应为人民利益服务。
Kējì yīng wèi rénmín lìyì fúwù.
Science and technology should work for the good of the people.

Yídiǎn lìyì guīyú bèigào.

c.h: 忄 is a component form of 心.

to be startled; to be shocked; to be amazed

to release on bail; to bail

Nǐ yìnggāi zhǔdòng qù gēn tā jiěshì qīngchǔ.
You should actively go and explain things clearly to him.
经我解释他才明白过来。
Jīng wǒ jiěshì tā cái míngbái guòlái.
Not until I had explained to him did he begin to realize it.

床.o: Depicts a bed (爿) made from wood (木). Originally written as 爿 or 牀.
w: to get out of bed; to get up
x: 快点起床！
Kuài diǎn qǐchuáng!
Come on, get up!
周末就不要叫我起床了，妈妈。

Don't wake me up on weekends, mum.

謊.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 荒 represents the sound.

養.o: Phonosemantic compound. 食 represents the meaning and 羊 represents the sound.

I haven't been up to much, just being bored.

What did you chat with him about?

Today is a special day.

There is a huge gap in level between the two teams.

婊.o: Phonosemantic compound. 女 represents the meaning and 表 represents the sound.

良种的羊长肉很快。

Well-bred sheep lay on flesh quickly.

谊.o: Phonosemantic compound. 讠 represents the meaning and 宜 represents the sound. Simplified form of 誼.

明天下午有一场足球友谊赛。

There is a friendly football match tomorrow afternoon.

w: lit. to go into battle bare-breasted (idiom)

Wǒ de gēbo bèi wénzi yǎo le yī kǒu.
A mosquito bit me on the arm.
他的胳膊肘碰到了桌子。
Tā de gēbozhǒu pèngdào le zhuōzi.
His elbow bumped against the table.

c.h: Depicts a tied bag with a bottom.

囊.o: Phonosemantic compound. 襄 represents the sound and 橐 represents the meaning.
